units.source_text: 随伴小皇子来此的众年轻侍女，人人悲伤，自不必说。

en.t: The many young ladies-in-waiting who had accompanied the little prince here were all grieving, needless to say.

units.source_text: 她们在宫中看惯繁华景象，觉得此间异常凄凉。

en.t: Accustomed to the splendor of the palace, they found this place extraordinarily desolate.

units.source_text: 她们设想皇上悲痛之状，甚是同情，便劝告太君，请早日送小皇子入宫。

en.t: Imagining how deeply the emperor must be grieving, they felt great sympathy and urged the grandmother to send the little prince back to the palace soon.

units.source_text: 太君认为自己乃不洁之身，倘随伴小皇子入宫，外间定多非议。

en.t: The grandmother considered herself ritually unclean, and thought that if she accompanied the little prince into the palace, people outside would surely criticize her.

units.source_text: 而若不见此小皇子，即使暂时之间，也觉心头不安。

en.t: Yet if she could not see the little prince, even for a short while, her heart felt uneasy.

units.source_text: 因此小皇子入宫之事，一时未能断然实行。

en.t: For that reason, the matter of the little prince entering the palace could not be carried out decisively for the time being.
